question: Which NFA variant has the highest iron content, and what capacity did it keep at 1C in the rate test?
rendered: According to the text, the NFA variant with the highest iron content is NFA-F, which has 15% iron. In the rate test, NFA-A (which has 5% aluminum) maintained a capacity of ≈116 mAh g−1 at high C-rates of 1C, while NFA-F (which has 15% iron) maintained a capacity of ≈81 mAh g−1 at the same rate.
